familyDefinition.purpose: Two persistent role families with a warm focal relation; useful when blue is already overloaded elsewhere in the manuscript.
familyDefinition.treatment: Pale plum and sage support repeated role identity; amber marks the chosen focal relation. The purple family has no universal memory meaning. Keep text dark and do not imply frozen/trainable state from tint.
